report.summary: Analyzed chunk 1 of daedalus/spine/attempt.py: module docstring with design rationale and imports. No public symbols defined yet. Claims about structural protections, failure states, ledger resolution, and import choices are documented but uncheckable without the rest of the code.

handoff.purpose: Module docstring and imports for TaskAttempt, the crash-safe seam for producing candidate changes.

claims.text: Every git invocation in this module goes through :func:`_git`, which raises :class:`PrimaryCheckoutWrite` if the working directory OVERLAPS the primary checkout IN EITHER DIRECTION...
claims.why: The chunk does not define `_git` or `PrimaryCheckoutWrite`.

claims.text: Mutating git (`add`) is only ever run with `cwd` set to the worktree, which lives outside the repo by construction (`GitWorktreeManager` places worktrees under `%LOCALAPPDATA%`).
claims.why: No definition of `GitWorktreeManager` or any git call in this chunk.

claims.text: The deliverable is :class:`PatchArtifact`: inert bytes. This module defines no function that applies a patch, checks out a ref, resets, merges, or commits to the primary checkout, and :data:`READ_ONLY_REPO_VERBS` makes adding one fail loudly rather than quietly work.
claims.why: `PatchArtifact` and `READ_ONLY_REPO_VERBS` are not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: :meth:`TaskAttempt._persist` now clears :func:`daedalus.primary_tree.assert_write_allowed` BEFORE `mkdir`, and a refusal is reported on the result rather than raised
claims.where: docstring, 'THE ONE CALLER-CHOSEN OUTPUT PATH IS FENCED'
claims.why: `TaskAttempt._persist` and `daedalus.primary_tree.assert_write_allowed` are not present in this chunk.

claims.text: ``SpineLedger()`` defaults to ``<repo>/runs/spine/spine.sqlite3`` (MEASURED), inside the primary checkout
claims.why: No definition of `SpineLedger` in this chunk.

claims.text: HEAD does not move, no tracked file changes, and ``git status --porcelain`` stays byte-identical -- which the test suite asserts after every scenario.
claims.where: docstring, end of primary-checkout writes section
claims.why: No test code in this chunk.

claims.text: :meth:`TaskAttempt.run` returns an :class:`AttemptResult` in every case. The states: storage_unavailable, worktree_failed, runner_failed, no_change, gates_failed, clean, cancelled.
claims.where: docstring, 'FAILURE IS A STATE, NOT AN EXCEPTION'
claims.why: `TaskAttempt.run` and `AttemptResult` are not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: Gates are skipped in that state [no_change] -- there is nothing to judge.
claims.why: No gate logic in this chunk.

claims.text: The recorded intent is 'produce a candidate patch', so it is COMPLETED whenever an artifact exists -- including ``gates_failed``... Intents are marked FAILED only when no artifact was produced at all.
claims.why: No ledger resolution code in this chunk.

claims.text: NOT `import shutil`. This module has no recursive delete of its own any more: the only one it had (the gate's scratch directory) goes through `remove_tree_no_follow` below.
claims.why: `remove_tree_no_follow` is not defined in this chunk.

observations.what: Module docstring is extensive and describes design rationale, but no code is present beyond imports.
Imports include hashlib, os, re, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time, uuid, dataclasses, functools, datetime, pathlib, typing. No 'import shutil' is present, matching the comment.
